impact_narrative: Checkout errors are likely blocking roughly 1,200 purchase attempts per minute while the error rate stays at 8%.
cause_summary: Commit a1b2c3d4e5 removed payment-intent state validation from confirm_payment and shipped in the deploy 20 minutes before the alert; unvalidated intents now fail at the gateway with 'payment intent state invalid'.

runbook_citation.heading_path: Checkout Service Runbook > High error rate after a deploy
runbook_citation.why: Covers rollback of a bad checkout deploy, which matches the suspected cause.

next_steps: Roll back the checkout deploy containing a1b2c3d4e5 (runbook section has the exact command).
Confirm 5xx rate returns to baseline (<0.5%) on the checkout dashboard.
Re-land the refactor with the middleware validation actually enabled.
